title: Superset Failures by Dashboard
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`) and REST API events.
app: Superset application and Celery worker logs via UF; Superset REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=superset:app status="error" OR level="ERROR"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dashboard_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Superset failures grouped by dashboard so operators immediately see which specific dashboards are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Superset is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Superset failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical dashboards.
visualization: Table of dashboard by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Superset are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
